question: Related Questions Q. Regarding umrah 2467 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 1753 Country: Pakistan Title: I went to Makkah from Jeddah and performed umrah alone. The next day I took my family to Jurana from Makkah without the intention of performing Umrah myself. My family performed umrah on returnin to makkah mukarima and i didnot. Is Dumh due on me or not? Question: I went to Makkah from Jeddah and performed umrah alone. The next day I took my family to Jurana from Makkah without the intention of performing Umrah myself. My family performed umrah on returnin to makkah mukarima and i didnot. Is Dumh due on me or not? Answer ID: 1753 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 591/588=D) When you went to Makkah and performed umrah you did not have to perform it again with your family. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
